title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Bethel Woods Center for the Arts, Bethel | 2019
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Bethel Woods Center for the Arts, Bethel, New York, USA, on 16 August 2019.

It was the 23rd show of the 14th All-Starr Band’s tour of Asia and North America, which lasted for 34 dates between March and September 2019.

Starr had previously performed at the Bethel Woods Center for the Arts on 26 June 2010 and 16 June 2012.

The 14th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, piano
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
